Usage: drive batch [<command>] [flags]

Print the current batch, or start, switch or list batches.

Inherited flags:
  -h, --help           Show context-sensitive help.
      --batch=NAME     Act in this batch, as drive prints its name, instead of the driver's current
                       one. It may stand anywhere on the line.
      --driver=NAME    Act as this driver, in its current batch: a chat driver is named by its
                       webhook. Where drivers each drive a batch, every command names one. It may
                       stand anywhere on the line.

Commands:
  show          Print the batch: its driver, start, wakes, Rex session, zone, sessions and directory
                (default).
  new <name>    Start a batch and make it its driver's current one.
  use <name>    Make a batch its driver's current one again.
  end           End the batch once its drive is over: its wakes stop, and it is no longer its
                driver's.
  list          List every batch, with its driver, each driver's current one starred.

Exit codes:
  0    success
  1    refused: nothing was done; next: says what to run instead
  2    invalid arguments; nothing was run
  3    tried and did not end as asked; the message says what did happen
  4    the session's login was rejected; next: relaunches it on another account, or says to tell the
       owner

Run "drive batch <command> --help" for a command's details.
